tools.name: wizishop_list_shops
tools.description: List the shops this WiziShop login can access, with their ids. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_get_shop
tools.description: Get one shop: name, domain, currency and status. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_list_products
tools.description: List products of a shop. Filter by status or SKU. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_get_product
tools.description: Get one product with its fields, prices and stock. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_list_orders
tools.description: List orders of a shop. Filter by status code range. Sort by a field, ascending or descending. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its lines, totals and status. Set is_public_id to look it up by its public id. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_list_customers
tools.description: List customers of a shop. Search by name or email. Read only.

tools.name: wizishop_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of a shop. Read only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wizishop_list_customers · Public sink: wizishop_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wizishop_list_customers · Public sink: wizishop_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
